import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'nuvem'))
from benchmark import solver_bridge as bridge
from benchmark.extract.from_solver import project_from_solver
from benchmark.runner import evaluate_project
m=bridge.engine()
import core.engine.wall_stepper as stepper
p=root/'nuvem/benchmark/projects/torre_easy_lo_r00_tp1'
data=json.loads((p/'input.json').read_text())
reference=json.loads((p/'reference.json').read_text())
nodes,walls,ends,openings=bridge.plan_from_input(data)
targets={95,138}
assert all(nodes[i]['kind']=='T_INTERSECTION' for i in targets)
original=stepper.solve_t_intersection
calls=[]
def hypothesis(*args,**kwargs):
    r=original(*args,**kwargs)
    ni=kwargs.get('node_index',args[3] if len(args)>3 else None)
    if ni in targets and r['ok']:
        r=dict(r,course_a=dict(r['course_b'],course='A'),course_b=dict(r['course_a'],course='B'))
        calls.append(ni)
    return r
before=hashlib.sha256((root/'nuvem/core/engine/wall_stepper.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
stepper.solve_t_intersection=hypothesis
start=time.perf_counter()
try:
    solved,walls,nodes,openings,catalog,base,courses,notes=bridge.run_solver(data)
finally:
    stepper.solve_t_intersection=original
assert before==hashlib.sha256((root/'nuvem/core/engine/wall_stepper.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
solved['num_courses']=courses
project=project_from_solver('torre_easy_lo_r00_tp1',solved,walls,nodes,openings,catalog,base,courses)
findings,score,comparison=evaluate_project(project,reference)
gate=m.controlled_beta_preflight(solved,walls,openings,catalog,base)
payload={'status':'NORMATIVE_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY_NOT_APPROVED','head':head,'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'input.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'targets':sorted(targets),'calls':calls,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'result_project':project,'findings':findings,'score':score,'comparison':comparison,'preflight':gate,'bond_audits':solved.get('wall_bond_audits'),'unmodulated_walls':solved.get('unmodulated_walls'),'intersection_failures':solved.get('intersection_failures'),'blocks':sum(len(v) for v in solved['course_candidates'].values()),'aggregate_collisions':len(solved['collisions'])}
with (root/'docs/checkpoints/evidence/beta-t-phase-tp1.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(payload,f,separators=(',',':'))
print(json.dumps({'seconds':payload['seconds'],'calls':len(calls),'blocks':payload['blocks'],'aggregate_collisions':payload['aggregate_collisions'],'physical_collisions':len(gate['collisions']),'opening_violations':len(gate['opening_violations']),'codes':score['findings_by_code'],'audit18':payload['bond_audits'][18]['problems'],'audit40':payload['bond_audits'][40]['problems']}))
